def find_convenient_fingering(n, notes):
    # Initialize the fingering with the first note and finger
    fingers = [0] * n
    current_finger = 1
    
    # Assign the first finger to the first note
    fingers[0] = current_finger

        if notes[i] > notes[i - 1]:
            # If the current note is higher, use a higher finger

                current_finger += 1

            # If the current note is lower, use a lower finger
            if current_finger > 1:
                current_finger -= 1
        # Assign the current finger to the current note
        fingers[i] = current_finger
        
        # Check if the current finger is the same as the previous finger
        if i > 0 and fingers[i] == fingers[i - 1]:
            return -1  # No convenient fingering exists
    
    return fingers
